name: Realizable Ample Classes Are Complement Closed
statement: The nonempty cube complement of a proper realizable ample class is realizable ample.
proof: Choose strict coordinate-sign witnesses for the class and positive signed separators for all minimally missing patterns. The open polar cone cut out by negative inner products with the class witnesses contains every separator. Each word outside the class extends a minimal missing pattern, so a small orthant-directed perturbation of its separator realizes that complementary word in the polar cone. A word of the original class cannot occur there because its own witness has positive inner product with every vector in its strict orthant. Exchanging the class and complement proves the converse.
